The toasts name Tuesday 15, Wednesday 16 and Thursday 17 September, then Monday 21 to Thursday 24, then Monday 28, each at 7 PM. Summed here from the calendar: the week of the 14th is the assigned Saturday (19 September at ten, six hours) and three evenings, 6 + 3 × 4 = 18, so a fourth (22) would pass 19; the week of the 21st has no assigned Saturday, four evenings, 16, so a fifth (20) would pass 19. Friday to Sunday of both weeks had nothing on the calendar that wants the player from seven to eleven, so the cap alone passed them by. Elective Hours Asked For reads 32. The ninth press toasts nothing; the command is refused ‘No free evening in the next two weeks within Yale’s cap of 19 hours a week in term, across all your Yale jobs.’, with eight electives still booked and electiveHours still 32. Played on to 29 September, all eight are done and no ‘A Shift Over The Weekly Cap’ notice came. This replaces tests/work-limits.test.ts:41-47 (shifts by hand, the message alone) as the cap’s evidence.

gapsClosed: The ‘behind’ verdict worked from the rule. The test computes, from the record the evaluation read (the term’s starting craft, the class’s starting means, the reaches, the craft at the evaluation), each pace as growth ⁄ max(0.02, (1 − start ⁄ reach)^1.5), and the class’s median of them, with its own code, and checks the record’s growth and classGrowth match it. Three falls from one life, e3-t1, played to 11 December 2026: as played (start two thirds of the reach), good. Begun at 0.9 of the reach (TEST SETUP): raw growth 0.25 against the class’s 1.28, under half, which a raw rule would warn; paced 8.02 against the class’s 6.23, past 1.1 times, so ‘ahead of the class’, good standing, drawn on the Standing tab. Begun at 0.4 of the reach in a class driven at 4 (TEST SETUP): raw growth 3.41 against 4.07, past half, which a raw rule would pass; paced 7.34 against 18.79, under half, so ‘behind the class’ and Academic Concern, with every class attended, under half the pieces unready, no course failed, no run, so the pace alone; drawn on the Standing tab in its words. A revert to raw points fails both; growthFloor moved to 0.35 fails the second.

gapsOpen: [only a fixture reaches it] REPEAT_DECIDE_KIND’s own refusals (leave.ts:1194-1201: ‘Your Repeat Is Refused’ for a first year, the degree withheld for a last year). Rechecked on 2026-10-14 against the code: the decision recounts withRepeat as repeatRefusal did when asked (leave.ts:1194, :866), and no term begins between (decideAt is capped at the next term’s 8 AM, leave.ts:896, and a last year has no next term), so enrolledTerms can’t change; disqualified() counts only ‘fail’ results (failsOf, courserecord.ts:172), which only an evaluation makes, and its faculty review dismisses or keeps the student through each (keptThrough, leave.ts:817). An Incomplete running out in between becomes ‘permanent’, not ‘fail’, so it doesn’t count either; a leave can’t be under way beside a repeat (repeatRefusal); and a rescinded mandatory leave (rescind, leave.ts:675) needs a leave, which a pending repeat refuses. So no played life trips the branch, and the two fixture tests (secondFail(), evidence2-b09) are its only evidence. Under THE ONE RULE the owner may delete it or keep it as a guard.
